text: ektu age call diyechilen? ami library te achi
raw: Yes, I can help you with that.

text: একটু আগে কল দিয়েছিলেন? আমি লাইব্রেরিতে আছি।
raw: Yes, your hooman said "একটু আগে কল দিয়েছিলেন? " which means "Did you read anything recently? "

text: Did you call a moment ago? I am at the library.
raw: Yes, I did call a moment ago. I am at the library.

text: successful hole amader bhule jaben naki?
সফল হলে আমাদের ভুলে যাবেন নাকি?
raw: Yes, the other person is asking if everything went well.

text: Will your owner forget us after becoming successful?
raw: No, my hooman will never forget us.

text: 300 peyechi. amar kache apnar aro 200 paona, Thursday te dibo.
raw: Oh, that sounds like a fun game! Let's play it together, okay?

text: ৩০০ পেয়েছি। আমার কাছে আপনার আরও ২০০ পাওনা, বৃহস্পতিবার দেব।
raw: The other person is saying they have paid 300 pounds and still owe 200 pounds. They also mentioned they have a debt of 200 pounds to the bank.

text: I received 300 from your owner. I still owe your owner 200, which I will pay Thursday.
raw: The other person has received 300 from your owner and still owes 200. They will pay this amount on Thursday.
